essence: One should examine duty and non-duty here in the manner of Gaṇeśa.
The rite is effective in pacifying all sins and destroying all calamities.
One should offer a lamp in a vessel made from a bilva leaf in a Śiva temple.
In the lineage of such a person, there will be neither poverty nor untimely death.
The lamp should be offered in the west for rain and in the north for other acts.
